orion._comment: invoice_prefix is this tenant's BSS invoice code prefix (DNSA, DNKW, ...); locations/tax/currency are per-tenant constants keyed off it. tax_code/tax_percent are emitted as TaxCode/TaxPercent (field names we proposed to the Orion team, see orion-api-sample.json). x_Currency/ExchangeRate/Rate now come from each invoice's own transactionCurrency/exchangeRate (amounts booked in LOCAL currency); currency/invoice_currency/exchange_rate here are reference only.

payment_term_map._comment: BSS payment method id (from GET /api/organization/paymentmethods) -> Orion PaymentTerm string

account_config._comment: Keyed by BSS billing (partner) account id, as a string -- i.e. invoice.billingTo.id, not invoice.account.id. Only sales_type + salesman are per-partner; locations are per-tenant (see orion section).
